disabled.description: Remove the built-in action with the same label

input_optional.description: Run even when the input is left empty

key.description: Key that runs the action directly (e.g. ctrl+r). Optional; every action is also listed under x. Keys used by ai-dash itself are ignored.

label.description: Name shown in the action picker. A configured action replaces the built-in action with the same label.

mode.description: 'resume' sends the prompt to the selected session; 'new' starts a new session in its project.

prompt.description: Prompt template. Fields: {{.Input}}, {{.Project}}, {{.SessionID}}, {{.Tool}}, {{.Summary}}, {{.Model}}. Using {{.Input}} asks for text first.

actions.description: Prompts to run against the selected session, from the x picker or their own key. Tool actions take precedence over generic ones.

age_presets.description: Date range options cycled with D key (e.g. 15m, 1h, 1d, 3d, 7d, 14d, 30d)

auto_select_tool.description: Skip tool picker and use default_tool automatically when creating new sessions

claude_path.description: Path to Claude Code projects directory (default: ~/.claude/projects)

default_age_filter.description: Default age filter applied to sessions on load and when clearing filters (e.g. 14d, 30d, 720h)

default_tool.description: Default tool for new sessions (e.g. claude, codex, opencode)

multiplexer.description: Terminal multiplexer used to open sessions when ai-dash runs inside one. 'auto' detects tmux/zellij from $TMUX/$ZELLIJ; 'tmux' or 'zellij' force a specific one; 'off' disables multiplexer use.

nerd_font.description: Use Nerd Font icons. Null/omitted means auto-detect via fc-list. Set false to force Unicode fallback.

opencode_path.description: Path to OpenCode SQLite database (default: ~/.local/share/opencode/opencode.db, or ~/Library/Application Support/opencode/opencode.db on macOS)

pi_path.description: Path to pi agent sessions directory (default: ~/.pi/agent/sessions)

poll_interval.description: How often to reload sessions (Go duration, e.g. 5s, 30s, 1m)

terminal.description: Terminal emulator to use when opening sessions (e.g. ghostty, kitty, alacritty, wezterm, foot). Defaults to $TERMINAL, then the first known terminal found on PATH.

tmux_mode.description: How sessions open under tmux. 'window' opens a new window and switches to it; 'background' opens a new window without switching; 'terminal' opens a new terminal emulator window running the session in its own tmux session.
